risk_items.finding: Backfill job may run with write access to both old and new tables; least-privilege is not specified.
risk_items.evidence: No mention of backfill service account permissions.
risk_items.why_it_matters: Overly permissive backfill roles increase blast radius if credentials leak.
risk_items.recommended_constraint: Backfill job should use a dedicated service account with write-only on canonical table and read-only on source.
risk_items.required_verification: IAM/role review of the backfill job.

blind_spots: Whether the new table inherits encryption and retention policies.
questions: Are row-level security policies needed on the canonical table?
recommended_task_graph_constraints: Security policy review for the canonical table before production.
recommended_verification_gates: IAM role definition test for backfill job.
